title: Australian Dollar edges lower as Fed hike bets grow ahead of Trump-Xi summit
summary: The AUD/USD pair trades with mild losses around 0.7120 during the early Asian session on Monday. The US dollar (USD) edges higher against the Australian Dollar (AUD) as the US Federal Reserve (Fed) delivered a 25-basis-point rate hike and flagged more hikes in the coming months.

title: Polls close in Russian wartime election with ruling party set to dominate
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has cast the vote as a test of support for his ongoing war in Ukraine.

title: Does Trump’s new AI Force signal tech race escalation ahead of Xi Jinping summit?
summary: US President Donald Trump has unveiled a new “AI Force” just days ahead of a state visit by Chinese leader Xi Jinping, in a potential escalation of the high-stakes technology race between the rival powers. Experts said the proposed AI Force – whose exact structure remains unclear – could give Beijing a clear counterpart for AI safety talks, but warned it risked becoming an instrument of further technological containment and export controls targeting China.
